gloss: difficult birth; troubled birth (of a plan)

definitions.explanation: A childbirth that is long or complicated.

definitions.gloss: troubled birth (of a plan, law or organization)
definitions.explanation: A plan, law, agreement or cabinet that comes into being only after long difficulty.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長女|ちょうじょ}→長女：14518_choujo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{難産|なんざん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{生|う}まれる→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{二日|ふつか}→二日：02954_futsuka⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: My eldest daughter was a difficult birth; it took two days for her to be born.

examples.japanese: {逆子|さかご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧{難産|なんざん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{予想|よそう}→予想：03664_yosou⟧⟦され→する：00392_suru⟧、{帝王切開|ていおうせっかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{出産|しゅっさん}する→出産する：26987_shussansuru⟧ことになった。
examples.english: The baby was breech, so a difficult birth was expected and it was decided to deliver by caesarean.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{法案|ほうあん}→法案：09758_houan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{難産|なんざん}だった。
examples.english: The new bill had a troubled birth.

examples.japanese: ⟦{組閣|そかく}→組閣：16543_sokaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{難産|なんざん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{末|すえ}→末：03362_sue⟧、ようやく⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
examples.english: After a troubled birth, the cabinet line-up was finally settled.

examples.japanese: ⟦{予算|よさん}{案|あん}→予算案：09761_yosanan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{与野党|よやとう}→与野党：31667_yoyatou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対立|たいりつ}→対立：04500_tairitsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{難産|なんざん}となり、⟦{成立|せいりつ}→成立：04353_seiritsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一|いっ}か{月|げつ}⟦{遅|おく}れた→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧。
examples.english: The budget had a troubled birth because of conflict between the ruling and opposition parties, and passed a month late.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {難産|なんざん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{末|すえ}→末：03362_sue⟧: after a difficult birth (literal or figurative)
- {難産|なんざん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to turn into a difficult birth

USAGE:
Sense 2 is common in political news, for a cabinet, a coalition, a budget or a law that took a long struggle to agree.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{安産|あんざん}→安産：18693_anzan⟧: an easy, safe birth (the opposite)
- ⟦{難航|なんこう}→難航：14584_nankou⟧: (of negotiations or work) to make heavy going, while it is still under way
